name: The Westin Resort & Spa, Himalayas
insider_take: Where the sacred Ganges whispers below and the snow-capped Himalayas tower above — this is luxury that feeds the soul.
whats_special: Perched in the spiritual heartland of Rishikesh — the world's yoga capital — The Westin Resort & Spa, Himalayas delivers a rare fusion of five-star indulgence and Himalayan serenity. The resort sits dramatically above the Ganges River, offering sweeping mountain views and direct access to one of India's most sacred landscapes. Its signature Heavenly Spa draws on ancient Ayurvedic traditions, while the resort's architecture echoes the natural contours of the surrounding terrain. Earn Marriott Bonvoy points through the Luminous Program while experiencing something truly transcendent.
pro_tip: Book your stay during the Rishikesh International Yoga Festival (typically March) for a once-in-a-lifetime immersion in yoga, meditation, and Himalayan culture — the resort's wellness programs align beautifully with the festival energy.
dont_miss: Sunrise Yoga on the Ganges Deck — greet the Himalayas at dawn with a guided session you'll never forget. Heavenly Spa Ayurvedic Treatments — rooted in 5,000-year-old healing traditions. White-Water Rafting on the Ganges — world-class rapids just minutes from your suite. Ganga Aarti Ceremony — witness the mesmerizing nightly fire ritual at Triveni Ghat.
pros: Breathtaking panoramic Himalayan mountain views from rooms and common areas
World-class Heavenly Spa offering rejuvenating wellness and holistic treatments inspired by local traditions
Luxurious Westin Heavenly Beds ensuring exceptional rest and comfort at high altitude
Distinctive dining experiences featuring regional Himalayan cuisine alongside international offerings
Marriott Luminous Program perks providing exclusive benefits and upgrades for eligible guests
cons: Remote mountain location requires significant travel time from major airports
High-altitude setting may present acclimatization challenges for some guests
Premium resort pricing reflective of its exclusive Himalayan destination
